title: Allergy Action Plan Form
subtitle: Capture allergen source, exposure route, current plan, and emergency supply; confirm symptom threshold and guardian update.
description: Allergy Action Plan records allergen source, exposure route, current plan, emergency supply, symptom threshold, and guardian update. Allergy Action Plan evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this allergy action plan operational record when staff must document allergen source and exposure route. Reconcile current plan, emergency supply, symptom threshold, and guardian update before the allergy action plan handoff. Use the current clinician action-plan reference, allergen list, medication-label match, emergency-supply seal and expiration, exposure record, and guardian receipt. Unlike a medication administration record, this plan centers exposure prevention, recognized threshold signs, emergency-supply access, school response roles, and return to review. Ask the assigned allergy action plan reviewer to confirm allergen source against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Allergy Action Plan starting details
sections.guidance: Preserve the named allergen, likely exposure setting, current qualified plan, emergency supply location, symptom threshold, and guardian notification route. Keep any urgent allergy action plan issue with its escalation contact and time.
